title: Services agency or firm
tagline: Marketing, design, IT services, recruitment, consulting, events — a team billing clients, in India and abroad.
who: Two or more partners starting a client-services business
Freelancers who have outgrown a one-person setup
Firms that will hire 5–50 people in the first years

structure.why: Partners get limited liability without the audit-every-year burden of a company (LLP audit only above ₹40 lakh turnover or ₹25 lakh contribution). Profit distribution is tax-free in partners’ hands after the LLP pays 30%; the LLP agreement handles exits. Choose a company instead if you plan to raise equity or sell the firm.
structure.alternatives: Private limited if clients are large enterprises that prefer companies or if you will raise money.

breakdown: LLP incorporation incl. DSCs and stamp duty: ₹6,000–15,000

timeline: LLP in 10–15 working days plus 30 days to file the agreement; GST in a week; hiring paperwork a few days.
taxes: LLP pays 30% + 12% surcharge above ₹1 crore + 4% cess; partner remuneration and interest are deductible within section limits; profit share is exempt for partners.
18% GST on domestic services; exports zero-rated under LUT; registration mandatory above ₹20 lakh (voluntary earlier for B2B credit).
Clients deduct TDS under 194J (10%/2%) or 194C (1%/2%) — track and claim.
You deduct TDS on salaries (192), rent (194-I), contractors (194C), professionals (194J).
selling: Retainers and projects; MSAs with SOWs
Marketplaces for services: Upwork, Clutch, GoodFirms, LinkedIn
Government work via GeM (needs Udyam) and tenders
sourcing: Subcontractors and freelancers — collect PAN, deduct TDS, sign IP assignment
Software and co-working — claim ITC on GST invoices in the LLP’s name
pitfalls: Not filing Form 3 (LLP agreement) within 30 days — ₹100/day forever.
Partner drawings booked as expenses — remuneration must be authorised by the agreement and within tax limits.
Hiring ‘consultants’ who are really employees — EPF/ESI, gratuity and POSH apply by substance.
Missing the 20-employee EPF trigger because interns and contract staff were not counted.
